Query_RunLog_Period.description: No partition restriction - RunLog's PartitionKey is monthly, and querying purely on StartTimeUtc across the whole table is simplest and cheap at this scale (max ~96 runs/day). Used ONLY for run-level metrics (runsExecuted/runsWithIssues) - file-level counts below no longer sum RunLog's per-run counters (see 2026-08-11 redesign note on Query_Copied_Period).

Query_Failed_Runs_Period.description: Separate targeted query rather than filtering the already-fetched Query_RunLog_Period results client-side (no filter() function exists) - length() of this query's own results gives the failed-run count directly.

Query_Copied_Period.description: Redesign (2026-08-11 - real bug found live: a dev-testing day produced 6 RunLog rows where FilesSeen was incremented per-file but no terminal bucket was ever recorded for those files, because the per-run counters summed here previously counted ATTEMPTS across every run in the period, not DISTINCT files - a file retried across multiple scheduled polls (or, worse, redeployed/retested code) got counted multiple times, and the count could never reconcile with the CSV attachment (built from ProcessedFiles' one-row-per-distinct-file current state). Fixed by deriving Copied/Failed/Abandoned directly from ProcessedFiles.Status (mutually exclusive - a distinct file has exactly one current status), the SAME source the CSV uses, so the headline numbers and the attachment always agree by construction.

Query_Failed_Files_Period.description: Distinct files whose CURRENT (latest) status is Failed - i.e. genuinely still stuck/retrying as of now, not every failure attempt that happened in the period (a file that failed twice then succeeded is counted once, under Copied, matching the CSV/ProcessedFiles - see Query_Copied_Period rationale).

Query_Abandoned_Period.description: Distinct files that transitioned to Abandoned during THIS period specifically (time-bounded) - distinct from Query_Abandoned_Backlog below, which is the full all-time unresolved list carried in every digest regardless of when abandonment happened.

Query_Skipped_Events_Period.description: 'Already on file' has no representation in ProcessedFiles at all (a skip is a no-op - nothing is upserted), so it is the one metric that must come from the new FileRunEvents audit table (added 2026-08-11 - user request: durable per-file-per-run tracking of what every run identified/ingested, kept indefinitely). A file skipped on every 15-min poll for the whole period produces many event rows for the SAME file - deduplicated to a distinct-file count below (Select_Skipped_DedupKeys + Compose_Distinct_Skipped), matching the same 'count files, not events' philosophy as the ProcessedFiles-based queries above.

Compose_Distinct_Skipped.description: union() against itself is the idiomatic WDL dedup trick (there is no distinct() function, and createArray() cannot be called with zero arguments - real bug found live, 2026-08-11: createArray() with no args throws InvalidTemplate, fixed by using the array itself as both union operands instead of an empty-array placeholder). Collapses repeat Skipped events for the same file (e.g. one already-copied file re-skipped on every 15-min poll all day) down to one count per distinct DedupKey.

Compose_TotalFilesSeen.description: 'Invoices detected' redefined (2026-08-11) as the count of distinct files with ANY activity this period (Copied + Failed + Abandoned + Skipped) - these four buckets are mutually exclusive per distinct file (a file's current ProcessedFiles status is exactly one of Succeeded/Failed/Abandoned, and Skipped-in-period only ever applies to files whose LastAttemptUtc falls outside this period, i.e. no overlap), so this sum has no double-counting.

Query_Files_Period.description: Full per-file detail for the CSV attachment - every file touched (copied, failed, or abandoned) in this period, regardless of current status. Unfiltered by Status because ProcessedFiles only ever stores Succeeded/Failed/Abandoned, so this is already exactly the union of Query_Copied_Period + Query_Failed_Files_Period + Query_Abandoned_Period - kept as its own query since it needs full row detail, not just a count.

Query_Abandoned_Backlog.description: Carried forward in every digest until resolved (decision) - not time-bounded, so a failure never silently scrolls out of view after 24h.

Build_CSV_Rows.description: CSV escaping per RFC 4180 (double-quote fields, double internal quotes) PLUS CSV/formula-injection defense (security review finding, 2026-08-02): a filename or error message beginning with =, +, -, or @ would be interpreted as a formula by Excel when the recipient opens the attachment. Prefixing a single quote neutralizes this in Excel without changing the visible text, applied only to the free-text fields that can originate from outside our control (file share names, connector-echoed error text) or embed them (destination paths).

inputs.select: @{concat('"', replace(if(or(startsWith(string(item()?['FileName']), '='), startsWith(string(item()?['FileName']), '+'), startsWith(string(item()?['FileName']), '-'), startsWith(string(item()?['FileName']), '@')), concat('''', string(item()?['FileName'])), string(item()?['FileName'])), '"', '""'), '","', replace(if(or(startsWith(string(item()?['SourcePath']), '='), startsWith(string(item()?['SourcePath']), '+'), startsWith(string(item()?['SourcePath']), '-'), startsWith(string(item()?['SourcePath']), '@')), concat('''', string(item()?['SourcePath'])), string(item()?['SourcePath'])), '"', '""'), '","', replace(if(or(startsWith(string(item()?['DestinationUrl']), '='), startsWith(string(item()?['DestinationUrl']), '+'), startsWith(string(item()?['DestinationUrl']), '-'), startsWith(string(item()?['DestinationUrl']), '@')), concat('''', string(item()?['DestinationUrl'])), string(item()?['DestinationUrl'])), '"', '""'), '","', replace(if(or(startsWith(string(item()?['IntendedDestinationPath']), '='), startsWith(string(item()?['IntendedDestinationPath']), '+'), startsWith(string(item()?['IntendedDestinationPath']), '-'), startsWith(string(item()?['IntendedDestinationPath']), '@')), concat('''', string(item()?['IntendedDestinationPath'])), string(item()?['IntendedDestinationPath'])), '"', '""'), '","', item()?['Status'], '","', string(item()?['AttemptCount']), '","', item()?['ErrorCategory'], '","', replace(if(or(startsWith(string(item()?['ErrorMessage']), '='), startsWith(string(item()?['ErrorMessage']), '+'), startsWith(string(item()?['ErrorMessage']), '-'), startsWith(string(item()?['ErrorMessage']), '@')), concat('''', string(item()?['ErrorMessage'])), string(item()?['ErrorMessage'])), '"', '""'), '","', item()?['RunId'], '","', item()?['TriggerType'], '","', coalesce(item()?['TriggeredByWorkflow'], 'Unknown'), '","', string(item()?['LastAttemptUtc']), '"')}

Compose_CSV_Content.description: TriggeredByWorkflow column added 2026-08-11 (user request: CSV should show which WORKFLOW copied each file, not just RunId/TriggerType) - sourced from ProcessedFiles.TriggeredByWorkflow, populated by wf-copy-invoices from the caller's own workflow().name. coalesce(...,'Unknown') in Build_CSV_Rows covers rows written before this field existed.

Call_Send_Digest_Email.description: Delegates all HTML branding/formatting to the single shared template (wf-send-digest-email), also used by wf-run-digest for immediate on-demand-run digests, so both always render identically (decision, 2026-08-10 - user request for proper branding/business-ready messaging). filesSeen/Copied/Skipped/Failed/filesAbandonedThisPeriod are now all distinct-file counts sourced from ProcessedFiles + FileRunEvents (2026-08-11 redesign) rather than summed RunLog attempt counters, so they always reconcile with the CSV attachment built from the same ProcessedFiles data.

body.periodLabel: @{concat('Period: ', formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(variables('PeriodStartUtc'), 'Mountain Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' to ', formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(variables('PeriodEndUtc'), 'Mountain Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' (America/Edmonton)')}
